# Home

John Prance’s portfolio landing page, introducing his design and technology practice and inviting collaboration.

## Visible sections

- Hero introduction with portrait, social links, and project CTA.
- Infinite service scroller.
- “What I do” section with three service cards.
- Collaboration and contact cards.
- Social follow section.
- Direct contact section and footer.

## Build mechanics

The page is composed from native Container, Grid, Flex, Text, Button, Image, and SVG components, plus the reusable [[entities/infinite-scroller]] custom component. Responsive typography, spacing, alignment, and wrapping protect the hero on smaller screens.

## Design notes

The visual language is bold and neobrutalist: heavy dark borders, offset hover shadows, bright coral, yellow, green, and lavender accents, geometric headings, and generous section spacing. Theme-backed dual colours provide light and dark variants.

## Concerns

- Dark-mode variants require verification whenever new cards, icon fills, or accent sections are added.

# Infinite Scroller

Reusable custom component for an automatically looping text marquee.

## Build mechanics

The component uses a multiline inspector property where each non-empty line becomes one scrolling item. Build-time hooks split and sanitise the lines, derive animation settings, and provide a separator. The template renders two identical flex sets so the track can animate continuously; CSS controls the loop, speed, direction, overflow, and natural text wrapping. Alpine pauses on hover and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

title: Project Overview
summary: Goals, structure, and design intent of this project

## Purpose

A personal portfolio for John Prance, a designer and technology enthusiast. It introduces his approach, highlights his strengths across digital design, brand identity, and creative technology, and invites prospective collaborators to get in touch.

## Target Audience

Founders, teams, and creative collaborators looking for a thoughtful design partner for digital products, brand work, and technology-led ideas.

## Structure

- **Home** — portfolio landing page with introduction, service areas, and contact prompts.
- **Features** — an existing Elements product feature page retained in the project.

---
title: Writing Style
tags:

summary: Voice and tone guide — read before authoring any copy
---

## Voice & Tone

Warm, confident, and thoughtful. Speak to potential collaborators as peers, with a curious, practical optimism about design and technology.

## Sentence Rhythm

Use concise, active sentences. Pair clear functional language with one memorable, human phrase where useful. Keep supporting copy direct and easy to scan.

## Vocabulary

Favour: thoughtful, clear, useful, distinctive, considered, curious, collaborative, human, purpose. Avoid jargon, vague superlatives, and hard-sell claims.

## Person & POV

Use first person singular for John’s personal introduction and offers. Address visitors directly in contact prompts.

## Heading Style

Use sentence case. Headlines should be concise, purposeful statements such as “Design with curiosity. Build with purpose.”

## Caption & Label Style

Use clear action labels in sentence case; short section labels may be uppercase.

## See also
- [[style-visual]]

---
title: Visual Style
summary: Layout and visual conventions — read before building or restructuring pages
---

## Layout patterns

The Home page uses full-width stacked sections with contained inner content, generous vertical padding, and responsive grids. The hero centres content on small screens and shifts to left alignment from tablet sizes. Service cards use one column on mobile, two on tablet, and three on desktop.

## Colour palette

| Role | Light mode | Dark mode |
|---|---|---|
| Page background | Surface 50 (`#f5f7fa`) | Surface 950 (`#1f2632`) |
| Raised cards | White (`#ffffff`) | Surface 900 (`#303c4d`) |
| Card borders | Black (`#000000`) | Surface 700 (`#3b5169`) |
| Primary text | Black | Text 950 (`#f6f8f9`) |
| Supporting text | Black | Text 900 (`#eceff2`) |
| Accents | Coral, yellow, green, lavender, orange | Retain bright accents against deep neutral surfaces |

Dark mode should feel deep blue-grey rather than pure black. Use a clear elevation step between page surfaces and cards, softer blue-grey borders, and near-white text. Keep the bright neobrutalist accents, but avoid large luminous pastel backgrounds in dark mode.

## Typography

- Display/hero: Bricolage Grotesque, bold.
- Headings: Space Grotesk, bold.
- Body: Inter, regular.
- Headings use compact line height and strong scale contrast; body copy remains direct and readable.

## Spacing and rhythm

Sections use generous vertical spacing and contained horizontal gutters. Cards use substantial internal padding and consistent gaps. Mobile hero spacing and type scale are reduced, with larger values restored at tablet and desktop breakpoints.

## Image treatment

The hero portrait is square, circular-cropped, centred on mobile, and left-aligned on larger screens.

## Interaction and surfaces

Cards and labels use thick borders, small upward/left hover movement, and offset black shadows. In dark mode, borders shift to Surface 700 while hover shadows remain black for visual depth. Social icons use near-white fills with yellow hover accents.

## Navigation structure

The current single-page portfolio has no primary navigation. Calls to action and social icons provide the main interaction paths.

## See also
- [[style-writing]]
- [[pages/home]]
